raw:
“I remember a branch falling and hitting the porch. There was this sharp crack just overhead, and that was the frightening part—the sound before I really knew what was happening. My attention went straight up, and then to the porch, trying to work out where it had landed.

There were splinters beside the porch swing. That detail sticks with me, more than the order everything happened in. A porch swing is something you think of as a quiet place to sit, and then seeing those splinters there made it feel very different. I kept thinking how close it was. I don’t remember who else was around, if anyone. What I remember clearly is that crack and the branch hitting, and being scared before I’d even had time to think.”
